chunks: 9 - He said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Umar al-Ji'abi informed me, he said: Abu al-Abbas Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id narrated to us, he said: Ali ibn al-Hasan al-Taymali narrated to us, he said: I found in the book of my father: Muhammad ibn Muslim al-Ashja'i narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Nawfal ibn A'idh al-Sayrafi, who said:

I was with al-Haytham ibn Habib al-Sayrafi when Abu Hanifa al-Nu'man ibn Thabit entered upon us. Then we mentioned the Commander of the Faithful Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) and a discussion arose between us about Ghadir Khumm,

Abu Hanifa said: "I have told my followers: never confirm to them the tradition of Ghadir Khumm, for they will argue against you." The face of al-Haytham ibn Habib al-Sayrafi changed, and he said to him: "Why would they not confirm it? Do you not have it as authentic, O Nu'man?" He said: "Yes, I have it and I have narrated it." He said: "Then why should they not confirm it, while Habib ibn Abi Thabit narrated to us, from Abu al-Tufayl, from Zayd ibn Arqam, that Ali (peace be upon him) adjured the people by God at Rahba to testify who had heard it?" Abu Hanifa said: "Do you not see that controversy arose regarding it until he had to put people on oath?" Al-Haytham said: "So should we call Ali a liar or reject his claim?" Abu Hanifa said: "We do not call Ali a liar nor do we reject what he said, but you know that some people have gone to extremes." Al-Haytham said: "The Messenger of God, may God bless him and his family, proclaimed it and preached about it, and yet we fear mentioning it and avoid it because of the extremism of an extremist or the words of someone?"

Then someone came and interrupted the discussion with a question he asked. The discussion became common knowledge in Kufa. Habib ibn Nizar ibn Hayyan was with us in the market, and he came to al-Haytham and said: "I have come to know what took place between you about Ali (peace be upon him) and the response given." Habib was a client of Banu Hashim. Al-Haytham told him: "There is more to the matter than meets the eye." And then the matter was dropped.

Later we went for Hajj with Habib, and we called upon Abu Abdillah Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them both). We greeted him, and Habib said: "O Abu Abdillah, such and such discussion took place." The face of Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) revealed displeasure. Habib said: "This is Muhammad ibn Nawfal, who was present at the discussion." Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:

"O Habib, restrain yourself! Deal with the people according to their ways, and distinguish yourselves by your deeds. For everyone will get that which he earns, and on the Day of Resurrection one will be with those whom one loved. Do not impose upon people against yourselves or against us. Enter into the masses of the people! For there are days of our rule which God will bring when He wills." Then Habib fell silent. He (peace be upon him) said: "Do you understand, O Habib? Do not disobey my command, lest you regret." He said: "I shall never disobey your command."

Abu al-Abbas said: I asked Ali ibn al-Hasan about Muhammad ibn Nawfal, and he said: "He was from Kufa." I asked: "Affiliated with whom?" He said: "I suppose he was a client of Banu Hashim." And Habib ibn Nizar ibn Hayyan was also a client of Banu Hashim. The incident between him and Abu Hanifa coincided with the rise of the Abbasids, so they could not openly express what the Family of Muhammad (peace be upon them) stood for.

key_terms.تقية: Taqiyya - dissimulation or prudent concealment of one's beliefs in dangerous circumstances
key_terms.دهماء الناس: Dahma al-nas - the common masses; blending in with ordinary people
key_terms.دولة: Dawla - sovereignty, state, or turn of power; here referring to the future rule of Ahlulbayt
key_terms.غدير خم: Ghadir Khumm - the location where the Prophet designated Ali as his successor on the return from the Farewell Pilgrimage

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq say about the hadith of Ghadir Khumm and practicing taqiyya?
ai.summary: This narrative recounts a debate between Abu Hanifa and al-Haytham al-Sayrafi about the hadith of Ghadir Khumm, where the Prophet designated Ali as his successor. Abu Hanifa advised his followers not to confirm the hadith to avoid losing arguments, while al-Haytham defended its authenticity. When the matter reached Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq during Hajj, he counseled taqiyya (dissimulation) -- to blend in outwardly while maintaining righteous deeds privately, and to trust in God's timing for the establishment of their just rule. The incident is contextualized within the early Abbasid period when open expression of Shia beliefs was politically dangerous.
